topic.title: XML Comments
topic.shortdesc: This topic carries plain XML comments, not Oxygen review comments, in every position where a comment is allowed.

section.title: Overview
section.p: The Authentication Service validates user credentials and issues signed access tokens.
Tokens are signed with the key configured in auth.signing.key. Any instance can serve any request.
The service exposes a health endpoint on the same port.
Metrics are exposed in Prometheus format.

section.title: Configuring the service
section.p: The configuration file is read once, at startup.

ul.li: A JDK 21 runtime is installed on the host.
The database schema is migrated to revision 42.
